title: ever REIKO|Satin One Shoulder Ruched Side Split Mermaid Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
This stunning maxi dress showcases a sleek one-shoulder design and ruched detailing, offering a flattering fit for any body type. The luxurious satin fabric glides gracefully, while the side split adds a touch of allure, making it perfect for elegant events. Ideal for bridesmaids, it pairs beautifully with statement accessories for a chic, polished look.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Tea-Length


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless


Closure: Concealed side zipper


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises satin


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch
